About Entrupy

Entrupy is a global technology company whose mission is to protect businesses, borders and consumers from transacting in counterfeit goods. Entrupy has developed a patented technology system which utilizes a combination of AI and computer vision to instantly identify and authenticate high value physical goods.
Entrupy’s solutions serve business customers including leading luxury brands, retailers, e-commerce marketplaces and online resellers in over 60 countries. Entrupy is growing quickly with team members based in the US, India, Japan and Brazil. Entrupy’s solutions in market:
● Entrupy Apparel Authentication
● Entrupy Bags & Leather Goods Authentication
● Entrupy Sneaker Authentication
● Entrupy Fingerprinting

As we continue to build...

We’re seeking curious, growth minded thinkers to help shape our vision, structures and systems; playing a key-role as we launch into our ambitious future. If you’re invigorated by our mission, values, and drive to change the world — we’d love to have you apply.

About the Role

As we expand branded luxury jewelry as a key category, we’re looking for a domain expert to help scale and strengthen our authentication capabilities globally, with a focus on North America.

We already have an established foundation in APAC, and this role will be critical in building depth, consistency, and regional expertise in North America, while partnering closely with the existing team. You will focus exclusively on high-end, branded jewelry (e.g., Cartier, Tiffany, Van Cleef & Arpels, etc.), bringing deep expertise in brand-specific construction, hallmarks, and authentication nuances.

If you are passionate about luxury craftsmanship, brand heritage, and scaling expertise across regions, this is a unique opportunity to play a pivotal role in a growing category.

Reports to Manager, Apparel
Location: US
Employment Type: Remote

What you’ll do:

  • Scale and enhance branded jewelry authentication capabilities in partnership with the APAC team
  • Authenticate high-value branded jewelry pieces, contributing to critical, high-risk evaluations
  • Build and refine structured knowledge systems (brand-level taxonomies, hallmark libraries, construction guides)
  • Develop and localize training programs and certification materials for global teams
  • Research luxury jewelry brands, collections, and brand-specific identifiers to deepen category expertise
  • Support the expansion of luxury apparel expertise in North America, ensuring consistency in authentication quality
  • Coach and mentor team members to foster a high-precision, knowledge-first culture

What you bring:

  • 3 to 5+ years of experience in branded luxury jewelry authentication, resale, or appraisal
  • Deep expertise in brand-specific hallmarks, engravings, construction techniques, and identifiers (e.g., Cartier, Tiffany, Van Cleef & Arpels, Bulgari, etc.)
  • Strong understanding of luxury jewelry brand portfolios, collections, and market positioning
  • Experience building training materials, playbooks, or structured knowledge systems
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to make high-stakes authentication decisions
  • Strong communication skills — able to codify expert judgment into scalable processes
  • Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable working cross-functionally in a global environment
  • Passion for authenticity, craftsmanship, and scaling expertise in luxury categories

The starting salary for this role is between $55,000 - $70,000, depending on skills and experience. We have competitive pay bands for all other countries based on market standards. Individual compensation decisions are based on several factors, including experience level, skill set, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. Based on these factors, we expect most of the candidates offered roles at our company to fall within the range. We recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than the requirements stated in this job description, as posted. If so, the updated salary range will be communicated to you as a candidate.

Entrupy embraces a diversity of backgrounds and experiences and provides equal opportunity for all applicants and employees. We are dedicated to building a company that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work (and work environment) will be for everyone.

About Frontier

Frontier is a subsidiary of Fresh Prints. Fresh Prints is a New York-based, fast-growing, fully remote, 380-person company that has most of our team in India and the Philippines. A few years ago, Fresh Prints started helping other fast-growing companies build their teams. We got so good at it that we decided to spin out a new company to focus exclusively on that and call it Frontier.

Here at Frontier, we help companies grow full-time, cross-functional teams abroad. We hire the smartest people, and we place them in the best companies. We have placed over 800 hires across 50 different US-based startups and high-growth companies.

About the Client:

EverSpark is a technology-forward custom jewelry manufacturing platform powering independent jewelry designers, retailers, and enterprise brands. Our platform enables customers to design, render, price, revise, approve, and manufacture custom jewelry through a seamless digital workflow.

We combine manufacturing expertise with modern software, AI-assisted design tools, and a high-touch customer experience to streamline the end-to-end custom jewelry process.

Role Overview

We are hiring a Jewelry Account Manager / Customer Success Manager to manage customer relationships and guide clients throughout the custom jewelry design and manufacturing process.

This is a highly consultative, customer-facing role where you'll serve as the primary point of contact for customers. You'll help clients clarify design requirements, answer questions, coordinate with internal production teams, manage timelines, and ensure orders move smoothly from concept to delivery.

This role combines customer success, project coordination, pricing support, and production management, making it ideal for someone who enjoys both relationship management and operational execution.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, tech-savvy, an exceptional English communicator, and comfortable managing multiple high-value customer workflows in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Account Management

  • Manage inbound customer requests for custom jewelry pieces
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts
  • Communicate directly with customers via email, phone, and messaging platforms
  • Ensure a high-touch, responsive customer experience

Requirement Gathering & Order Clarification

  • Review customer submissions and identify missing or unclear information.
  • Ask thoughtful clarifying questions to fully understand customer requirements before production begins.
  • Translate customer requests into clear, actionable instructions for internal teams.
  • Guide customers through pricing, materials, manufacturing capabilities, and design trade-offs.
  • Ensure customer expectations are aligned with operational capabilities and production timelines.

Production & Internal Coordination

  • Coordinate closely with CAD designers, production, and operations teams throughout the manufacturing process.
  • Support CAD preparation and coordination by ensuring customer requirements are accurately translated into production-ready designs.
  • Assist with quote preparation and pricing coordination while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Track order progress from design through manufacturing and final delivery.
  • Ensure all required materials (e.g., stones, specifications, approvals) are received before production.
  • Escalate production or technical issues when needed.

Customer Follow-ups & Workflow Management

  • Follow up on pending approvals, missing customer inputs, or stalled orders.
  • Maintain accurate notes, customer communications, and order updates in internal systems.
  • Ensure customer projects continue progressing smoothly through every stage of production.
  • Support continuous improvement of internal workflows and customer processes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve organization, efficiency, and customer experience using technology or automation.

Required Qualifications

  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Strong verbal communication skills with a neutral, easy-to-understand accent suitable for communicating with US-based customers.
  • Strong listening skills with the ability to ask thoughtful follow-up questions and communicate complex information clearly.
  • 2+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Client Services, Operations, or similar customer-facing roles.
  • Experience managing multiple customer requests while working under tight deadlines.
  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Tech-savvy and able to quickly learn new systems and software.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive, ownership mindset.
  • Demonstrated ability to improve workflows, solve problems independently, or take initiative beyond assigned responsibilities.
  • Comfortable working US business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in jewelry, diamonds, gemstones, luxury products, or custom manufacturing environments.
  • Experience working with custom or bespoke jewelry manufacturing.
  • Experience with CAD preparation, CAD coordination, jewelry production workflows, quote preparation, or pricing coordination.
  • Experience balancing customer service responsibilities with operational or production support.
  • Experience working in fast-paced production environments with short turnaround times.
  • Prior exposure to SaaS platforms, marketplaces, CRM systems, AI tools, or workflow management software.
  • Experience at companies like Rare Carat, Nivoda, or similar jewelry or diamond technology companies is highly preferred.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Friendly, empathetic, and professional communicator who enjoys building relationships with customers.
  • Naturally curious and comfortable asking clarifying questions before making assumptions.
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
  • Calm and confident when managing customer conversations.
  • Comfortable balancing customer expectations with operational constraints.
  • Able to manage multiple customer projects simultaneously while maintaining accuracy.
  • Thrives in fast-paced environments with time-sensitive production schedules.
  • Comfortable handling both customer-facing responsibilities and operational work such as pricing, CAD coordination, and production tracking.
  • Demonstrates initiative by improving processes, building systems, or finding more efficient ways of working.
  • Strong ownership and accountability - you naturally take responsibility for ensuring customer orders move forward.
  • Excited to learn new technology and comfortable working with AI-enabled platforms and modern software.

About The Role

The RealReal is seeking established, highly autonomous luxury professionals with an existing book of business to join us as a Luxury Sales Specialist. This is a 100% commission-based role, offering ultimate flexibility and uncapped earning potential for independent self-starters who already possess a deep network within the high-net-worth sector.

As an LSS, you will act as a premier brand ambassador, leveraging your current relationships to strategically acquire high-value luxury consignment inventory from private clients. If you are a stylist, personal shopper, real estate agent, or luxury retail professional looking to monetize your existing network on a flexible, part-time basis, this role is built for you.

Note: This is a remote, field-based position open to many US cities. We invite qualified professionals to apply regardless of location.

* Eligible locations: AK, AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, DE, FL, GA, HA, IA, ID, IL, IN, KS, KY, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, MS, MT, NC, ND, NE, NH, NJ, NM, NY, OH, OK, OR, LA, PA, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, VT, WA, WI, WV, WY

What You Get To Do Every Day

  • Monetize Your Existing Network:Leverage your established book of business—including VIP contacts, stylists, personal shoppers, and affluent individuals—to source high-quality luxury consignments and drive new sellers to TRR.

  • Cultivate Elite Client Relationships:Maintain long-term, trust-based relationships with high net worth clients through a highly personalized, white-glove service.

  • Drive Independent Growth:Develop and execute your own creative outreach and networking strategies to consistently bring in high-end luxury consignments and cultivate deeper longer lasting client relationships.

  • Manage End-to-End Logistics:Secure luxury items from clients and seamlessly coordinate pickup, valuation, and secure shipment to our authentication centers.

  • Deliver Exceptional Service:Provide a flawless, premium experience throughout the consignment lifecycle to ensure maximum client retention and repeat business.

What You Bring To The Role

Minimum Requirements:

  • Established Book of Business:A robust, active personal and professional network capable of immediately generating recurring, high-value luxury consignment opportunities and new sellers.

  • Luxury Brand Expertise:Deep knowledge of and passion for top-tier luxury brands across Handbags, Fine Jewelry, Watches, and Ready-to-Wear.

  • Autonomous & Entrepreneurial Mindset: Proven ability to work independently, manage your own schedule, and drive results without daily oversight.

  • Sophisticated Relationship Management:Exceptional professionalism and the business acumen required to maintain trust with high-net-worth individuals.

  • Digital Proficiency: Comfort utilizing CRM tools and digital platforms to manage your client pipeline.

  • Mobility:Ability to travel within your regional market to meet clients on-site as needed.

    • A current, valid driver’s license (except in Manhattan and Chicago markets)

    • Car insurance meeting local requirements and a satisfactory Motor Vehicle Record (MVR)

Preferred Requirements:

  • Industry Background:Current or prior experience in personal styling, luxury retail sales, real estate, interior design, or high-end public relations.

Compensation, Benefits, + Perks

Compensation | Benefits | Perks

  • This is a part-time, 100% commission-based role, offering the ultimate freedom to run your business your way but with robust training and support to drive success.

  • Uncapped Commission Structure:Direct control over your income with no ceiling on your financial success—the more your network consigns, the more you earn.

  • Maximum Flexibility:Easily integrate this role into your current professional schedule or existing business practices.

  • Exclusive Incentives:Eligible for monthly performance competitions featuring cash bonuses and site credits.

This is a 100% commission-only role. Depending on role, employees may also be eligible for a bonus program, incentive pay and/or benefits.

The RealReal is the world’s largest online marketplace for authenticated, resale luxury goods, with 40 million members.
